# Homelab Infrastructure

[![CI](https://github.com/rambhiad/homelab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rambhiad/homelab/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Infrastructure as Code for my homelab environment running on Proxmox VE.

## Overview

This repository manages:

- **Proxmox VE Cluster**: Virtualization platform
- **Talos Kubernetes Cluster**: Immutable Kubernetes distribution
- **LXC Containers**: Lightweight Linux containers for various services
- **Supporting Infrastructure**: DNS, certificates, storage, and networking

## Quick Start

1. Install [Nix](https://nixos.org/download.html) and enable flakes
2. Clone this repository
3. Run `nix develop` to enter the development environment
4. Copy and configure secrets (see [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md))
5. Run `terraform init && terraform apply`

## Documentation

- [Architecture Overview](docs/architecture.md)
- [Setup Guide](docs/setup.md)
- [Bootstrapping](docs/bootstrapping.md)
- [Git-crypt Setup](docs/git-crypt.md)

## Tech Stack

| Component       | Technology                                                                            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| IaC             | [OpenTofu](https://opentofu.org/) / Terraform                                         |
| Secrets         | [SOPS](https://github.com/getsops/sops) + [Age](https://github.com/FiloSottile/age)   |
| Virtualization  | [Proxmox VE](https://www.proxmox.com/)                                                |
| Kubernetes      | [Talos Linux](https://www.talos.dev/)                                                 |
| GitOps          | [ArgoCD](https://argoproj.github.io/cd/)                                              |
| Ingress         | [ingress-nginx](https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/)                          |
| Load Balancer   | [MetalLB](https://metallb.universe.tf/)                                               |
| DNS             | [ExternalDNS](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns) + Cloudflare           |
| Certificates    | [cert-manager](https://cert-manager.io/) + Let's Encrypt                              |
| Storage         | [Longhorn](https://longhorn.io/) + [Democratic CSI](https://github.com/democratic-csi/democratic-csi) |
| Dev Environment | [Nix Flakes](https://nixos.wiki/wiki/Flakes)                                          |

## Repository Structure

```txt
├── cluster/           # Kubernetes manifests and configurations
│   ├── k8s/          # Helm charts and ArgoCD apps
│   └── lxc/          # LXC container cloud-init configs
├── docs/             # Documentation
├── modules/          # Terraform modules
│   ├── lxc-sidecars/ # LXC sidecar container management
│   ├── services/     # Proxmox service definitions
│   └── talos/        # Talos Kubernetes cluster
├── secrets/          # SOPS-encrypted secrets
└── *.tf              # Root Terraform configuration
```

# Architecture Overview

## Infrastructure Diagram

![Homelab Architecture](assets/homelab-architecture.svg)

## Network Layout

| Network          | CIDR              | Purpose                    |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------- |
| Management       | 192.168.1.0/24    | Proxmox, switches, APs     |
| Kubernetes Nodes | 192.168.10.0/24   | Talos node IPs             |
| Kubernetes LB    | 192.168.10.64/26  | MetalLB IP pool            |
| LXC Containers   | 192.168.20.0/24   | Service containers         |

## Components

### Proxmox VE Cluster

Single-node Proxmox VE installation serving as the hypervisor for all workloads.

### Talos Kubernetes

3-node Talos Linux cluster (1 control plane, 2 workers) managed via Terraform.

### LXC Containers

Lightweight containers for services that don't require Kubernetes:

- **Omada Controller**: TP-Link network management
- **DNS servers**: Pi-hole or similar
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus, Grafana (optional standalone)

### Storage

- **Local**: Proxmox local-lvm for VM/container disks
- **NFS**: TrueNAS for shared storage via Democratic CSI
- **Distributed**: Longhorn for replicated Kubernetes storage

## Summary

This is a **homelab infrastructure-as-code repository** that manages a personal home server environment using:

### Core Technologies
- **OpenTofu/Terraform** for infrastructure provisioning
- **Proxmox VE** as the virtualization platform
- **Talos Linux** for an immutable Kubernetes cluster
- **SOPS + Age** for secrets management
- **Nix Flakes** for the development environment

### Infrastructure Components

1. **Kubernetes Cluster** (Talos): 3-node cluster with ArgoCD for GitOps, MetalLB for load balancing, Longhorn for storage, and various supporting services (cert-manager, external-dns, ingress-nginx)

2. **LXC Containers**: 12 lightweight containers running various self-hosted services:
   - AdGuard Home (DNS/ad blocking)
   - Homepage (dashboard)
   - Omada Controller (network management)
   - Uptime Kuma (monitoring)
   - Nginx Proxy Manager (reverse proxy)
   - Actual Budget (finance)
   - Immich (photos)
   - Nextcloud (file sync)
   - Ollama (local LLM)
   - Paperless-ngx (documents)
   - Portainer (container management)
   - Plex (media server)

3. **Terraform Modules**:
   - `modules/services` - Proxmox LXC container definitions
   - `modules/lxc-sidecars` - Sidecar management including PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) backup configuration
   - `modules/talos` - Talos Kubernetes cluster configuration

### Repository Structure
- `cluster/k8s/` - Kubernetes Helm charts and ArgoCD applications
- `cluster/lxc/` - LXC container cloud-init configurations
- `modules/` - Reusable Terraform modules
- `secrets/` - SOPS-encrypted secrets for various services
- Root `.tf` files - Main Terraform configuration

The codebase is well-organized, follows infrastructure-as-code best practices, and uses a modular approach for managing both Kubernetes workloads and standalone LXC container services.
